notes.title: MULTIPLAYER UPDATE!
notes.content:
The time is finally here to release multiplayer mode to the public!
Please be patient with us as we work to get all features from single player working in multiplayer.

Right now, friends can explore the massive world and work together to create a base and fend off monsters. 

You can partner up with a max of 4 friends or randoms using the multiplayer room finder.

As well as multiplayer, we have released a few more new updates!

+added cheats to singleplayer
+removed mystery button replaced with coin button
+make so need 1 glass instead of sand to make window
+added bomb throwing using Q and E keys and ammo replenish in singleplayer
+bombs make enemies stunned for a short time in order to grab loot safely
+added harvest tile effect
+made so its esc and tab to open menu now
+added dialogue about bomb throwing on talking starter guy
+added controls panel to options

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
Our first update has arrived!!!!
 We decided to push back the multiplayer update a bit further...
We are still working to get all features available in multiplayer.

Here is what's NEW!
- Added a clock and time to tell time of day
- Time of day is now save and loadable
- Name of crafting item is now shown in crafting panel
- Adjusted rain settings
- Added new talkable NPC orc in the world
- Added new unlockable characters
- Created a character shop
- Added a craftable spawn point you can place in your home
